# Roomtodo

> > Roomtodo is an interior design platform offering multilingual guides, 3D design tools, and expert advice on color theory, spatial planning, and diverse design styles.

Roomtodo provides comprehensive resources for home design enthusiasts and professionals, covering everything from foundational design principles like the 70/20/10 color rule and 3-5-7 odd numbers rule to specific style guides including Oriental, Moroccan, Grunge, and Mountain Chalet aesthetics. The platform serves a global audience with content available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, and Ukrainian.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design Principles
- Color Theory & Color Rules
- 70/20/10 Rule
- 3-5-7 Rule (Odd Numbers)
- Function, Form & Feeling (Three Fs)
- Complementary Colors
- Design Styles (Oriental, Moroccan, Grunge, Brutalist, Chalet)
- Space Planning & Layout
- Feng Shui
- 3D Design Tools
- Dark Color Schemes
- Natural Lighting & Windows
- Mirror Placement
- Exhibition Stand Design

## Design Principles & Color Theory

- [Latest news and developments – Roomtodo](https://roomtodo.com/en/blog): Blog hub with interior design tips and Roomtodo product updates
- [The 70/20/10 Color Rule in Interior Design](https://roomtodo.com/ru/blog/mastering-color-what-702010-rule-interior-design): Mastering the 70/20/10 color rule for harmonious interiors
- [The 3-5-7 Rule: Magic of Odd Numbers](https://roomtodo.com/ua/blog/the_3-5-7_rule_in_interior_design_the_magic_of_odd_numbers): Using odd numbers (3-5-7 rule) for visual appeal in interior decor
- [The 3-5-7 Rule in Interior Design](https://roomtodo.com/ru/blog/the_3-5-7_rule_in_interior_design_the_magic_of_odd_numbers): Odd numbers rule (3-5-7) for creating visual harmony in any room
- [The Three Fs of Interior Design: Function, Form, and Feeling](https://roomtodo.com/pt/blog/the_three_fs_of_interior_design_the_secret_to_a_balanced_home): Guide to balancing Function, Form, and Feeling in interior design
- [Complementary Colors: World of Contrast](https://roomtodo.com/ru/blog/complementary-colors-world-contrast): Using complementary colors and contrasts in interior design
- [Combining Warm and Cool Color Tones](https://roomtodo.com/es/blog/union-warm-and-cool-shades-interior): Combining warm and cool color tones in interior design

## Space Planning & Layout

- [How to Plan Your Home Layout Like a Pro: Tips and Tools](https://roomtodo.com/en/blog/5252): Professional home layout planning tips and design tools
- [How to Arrange Mirrors in Interior](https://roomtodo.com/de/blog/how-arrange-mirrors-interior): Mirror placement guide using Feng Shui and space enhancement techniques
- [Huge Windows in Interior House](https://roomtodo.com/ru/blog/huge-windows-interior-house): Impact of large windows on natural lighting and room design
